newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Northwest spot products notionally unchanged.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Northwest spot products notionally unchanged.

text.p: U.S. Northwest products prices were notionally unchanged, contained by lackluster California markets and no reports of refinery problems.
California products flattened late Thursday, as players avoided making purchases until NYMEX volatility calmed.
Conventional regular unleaded gasoline in Los Angeles traded at 62/63 cents a gallon.
In Seattle, regular unleaded gasoline was assessed notionally at 62.50 cents to 63.50 cent a gallon, flat from Wednesday.
Low sulphur diesel stayed 75/76 cents and jet feul remained 76.50/77.50 cents a gallon.
